faqs.question: What is the difference between a deodorant and an antiperspirant?
faqs.answer: Deodrants directly fight sweat-causing bacteria. Antiperspirants contain actives which reduce sweat by clogging sweat pores. These pores get unclogged naturally due to the skin renewal process.

faqs.question: Will it leave patches on clothes?
faqs.answer: No, if you allow the product to absorb before wearing clothes, it won't leave patches.

faqs.question: Can I use it directly post-waxing?
faqs.answer: We'd suggest keeping a gap of 6-12 hours to use this deodrant post waxing.

faqs.question: How much time will it take to see results?
faqs.answer: We recommend checking with the doctor as results will vary depending on the condition: however you should start noticing a change within 3 months

faqs.question: Can I use this product twice a day?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use this product on clean skin, daily, twice a day.
